known_limitations: No ImplementationRun, RunRelationship, detail, reference, annotation, artifact-location, or ChangedFile/ChangedSymbol technical-ID mapper exists.
No production Repository integration, Session, Unit of Work, database connection, migration, Parser/Indexer, API, or UI exists.
Task mapping creates new version-1 records only; existing-record update and optimistic concurrency paths are not implemented.
Manifest v1 logical repository identity and current ORM Mapper/identity version persistence remain unresolved.
Real PostgreSQL and pinned SQLAlchemy behavior were not tested.
unresolved_questions: How will the Run Mapper receive explicit trusted logical repository identity without interpreting the Manifest absolute path?
How will the future Repository own expected-version updates and translate persistence conflicts?
Where will Mapper and identity algorithm versions be persisted before indexing?
rollback_information: Revert the single containing commit. No database, schema, migration, data, API, dependency, lockfile, accepted ADR, business runtime, or Factor Lab rollback is required.
security_impact: Mapper errors expose stable bounded metadata and omit complete records, objectives, scopes, non-goals, database URLs and secret-like identities; no external input or database was accessed.
data_lineage_impact: No research or database data changed; Task conversion now has deterministic contract-versioned semantics but no durable persistence/indexing was performed.
